pain_point: Fear of buying at the wrong time - What if the market drops after I buy? Should I wait for rates to come down?
headline_outcome: Your Rent Is the Bigger Risk
primary_text: "What if the market drops after I buy?" Let's talk about what's definitely happening while you wait: your landlord is raising your rent. Again. Every year you delay, you lose $30-50k+ in rent with zero equity to show for it. Off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina let you lock pricing today and settle later. Melbourne's western industrial land supply is finite — they're not making more of it. Owner-occupiers across trades, logistics, and manufacturing are snapping up these units. The only guaranteed loss is the rent you'll never get back.
description: Stop losing $30-50K+ per year in rent with nothing to show for it
